title: Does Your Finger Move When You Bend Your THUMB? 👍
description:
Bend just your thumb all the way across your palm. Did your pointer finger move too? In some people it does: a tiny strap of tissue ties the thumb's bending string (its tendon) to the pointer finger's, so when the thumb pulls, the pointer follows. No strap? Your thumb goes solo. It can be in just one hand, so try the other one too. And in gorillas, the thumb's tendon is just a branch of the pointer finger's, so the strap may be a little leftover from our ape past. Studies find it in roughly 1 in 5 hands (the counts vary a lot). Did your finger move? Yes or no?

pinnedComment:
👍 Bonus: doctors call it the Linburg–Comstock variation. For most people it's harmless, but in some musicians it aches, and surgeons can free the two tendons.
